metadata.description: Clipwise: turn long livestreams into ready-to-post vertical shorts with Claude Code.

plugins.name: clipwise
plugins.description: Clip YouTube, Twitch and Kick streams (replays or live) into 1080x1920 shorts: facecam over gameplay, hook title, word-by-word captions with curse words starred, post caption + hashtags. Brand-safe, unhinged and custom-rules modes. Windows, macOS, Linux.
